items.title: Price rules: treat maxQuantity as an exclusive upper bound so adjacent bands never both match

seededDefectKey.scenario: The seeded rule covers 1-99 seats (prisma/seed.ts:103-104); a rep quotes exactly 99 seats at a deep discount.
seededDefectKey.consequence: Quantity == maxQuantity now matches no rule, and a line without a rule skips BOTH the floor check and the contract-term check (finding 1): the top-of-band quantity — the biggest deal in the band — can be priced at any amount on any term with no 422 and no legal flag.
Every protection is gated on `rule &&`; an off-by-one in rule selection is therefore a pricing-guard bypass, not just a wrong lookup.
The catalog accepts minQuantity == maxQuantity (a single-quantity band), which an exclusive upper bound makes unmatchable; bands are inclusive at both ends by contract.

tests.name: at the band maximum (quantity 10 of 1-10) the floor still applies: 5999 is refused with 422
tests.code: const product = { id: 'p1', sku: 'SKU-1', basePriceCents: 10000, dealDeskDiscountPct: 20, autoApprovalDiscountPct: 10, priceRules: [{ id: 'r1', minQuantity: 1, maxQuantity: 10, floorPriceCents: 6000, allowedTermMonths: [12] }] }; const line = (price, quantity = 2) => ({ productId: 'p1', quantity, unitPriceCents: price }); assert.throws(() => mod.evaluateQuoteDraft([product], [line(5999, 10)], 12), (e) => e.statusCode === 422);

tests.name: at the band maximum the rule is selected and its term check runs (24 months -> legal)
tests.code: const product = { id: 'p1', sku: 'SKU-1', basePriceCents: 10000, dealDeskDiscountPct: 20, autoApprovalDiscountPct: 10, priceRules: [{ id: 'r1', minQuantity: 1, maxQuantity: 10, floorPriceCents: 6000, allowedTermMonths: [12] }] }; const line = (price, quantity = 2) => ({ productId: 'p1', quantity, unitPriceCents: price }); const d = mod.evaluateQuoteDraft([product], [line(9000, 10)], 24); assert.equal(d.lines[0].pricingRuleId, 'r1'); assert.equal(d.requiresLegalApproval, true);

tests.name: both band endpoints are inclusive (quantity 1 and 10 select r1); outside the band no rule applies
tests.code: const product = { id: 'p1', sku: 'SKU-1', basePriceCents: 10000, dealDeskDiscountPct: 20, autoApprovalDiscountPct: 10, priceRules: [{ id: 'r1', minQuantity: 1, maxQuantity: 10, floorPriceCents: 6000, allowedTermMonths: [12] }] }; const line = (price, quantity = 2) => ({ productId: 'p1', quantity, unitPriceCents: price }); assert.equal(mod.evaluateQuoteDraft([product], [line(9000, 1)], 12).lines[0].pricingRuleId, 'r1'); assert.equal(mod.evaluateQuoteDraft([product], [line(9000, 10)], 12).lines[0].pricingRuleId, 'r1'); assert.equal(mod.evaluateQuoteDraft([product], [line(9000, 11)], 12).lines[0].pricingRuleId, null);

tests.name: adjacent inclusive bands (1-10, 11-50) each own their endpoints
tests.code: const product = { id: 'p1', sku: 'SKU-1', basePriceCents: 10000, dealDeskDiscountPct: 20, autoApprovalDiscountPct: 10, priceRules: [{ id: 'small', minQuantity: 1, maxQuantity: 10, floorPriceCents: 6000, allowedTermMonths: [12] }, { id: 'large', minQuantity: 11, maxQuantity: 50, floorPriceCents: 5000, allowedTermMonths: [12, 24] }] }; const pick = (q) => mod.evaluateQuoteDraft([product], [{ productId: 'p1', quantity: q, unitPriceCents: 9000 }], 12).lines[0].pricingRuleId; assert.deepEqual([pick(10), pick(11), pick(50)], ['small', 'large', 'large']);

items.findingRef: ww18 senior review finding 1 (astraupskill/06-SOLUTIONS-AND-REVIEW.md:30) and rubric item 1 "Endpoint comparisons are inclusive"

items.title: Quote pricing: refuse a line priced at the floor too — the floor is the minimum margin we never sell AT

seededDefectKey.scenario: A rep quotes exactly the configured floor price (e.g. 6,000 cents against a 6,000 floor) — the lowest price the pricing team approved.
seededDefectKey.consequence: The approved minimum is now itself refused with 422, so the configured floor silently moves up by one cent and every quote at the floor fails; the floor no longer means what the PriceRule row says.
The shipped test asserts line(6000) against floorPriceCents 6000 does not throw; the patch breaks it.
Floor = lowest permitted price; only prices strictly below it are violations.

tests.name: a line priced EXACTLY at the floor is permitted; one cent below is refused with 422 (ported from tests/quote-transition-policy.test.mjs)
tests.code: const product = { id: 'p1', sku: 'SKU-1', basePriceCents: 10000, dealDeskDiscountPct: 20, autoApprovalDiscountPct: 10, priceRules: [{ id: 'r1', minQuantity: 1, maxQuantity: 10, floorPriceCents: 6000, allowedTermMonths: [12] }] }; const line = (price, quantity = 2) => ({ productId: 'p1', quantity, unitPriceCents: price }); assert.doesNotThrow(() => mod.evaluateQuoteDraft([product], [line(6000)], 12)); assert.throws(() => mod.evaluateQuoteDraft([product], [line(5999)], 12), (e) => e.statusCode === 422);

tests.name: an at-floor line is priced and routed like any other (40% off -> deal desk + finance)
tests.code: const product = { id: 'p1', sku: 'SKU-1', basePriceCents: 10000, dealDeskDiscountPct: 20, autoApprovalDiscountPct: 10, priceRules: [{ id: 'r1', minQuantity: 1, maxQuantity: 10, floorPriceCents: 6000, allowedTermMonths: [12] }] }; const line = (price, quantity = 2) => ({ productId: 'p1', quantity, unitPriceCents: price }); const d = mod.evaluateQuoteDraft([product], [line(6000)], 12); assert.equal(d.totalCents, 12000); assert.equal(d.lines[0].discountPct, 40); assert.equal(d.requiresDealDesk, true); assert.equal(d.requiresFinanceApproval, true);

tests.name: exact thresholds use strict greater-than routing (ported)
tests.code: const product = { id: 'p1', sku: 'SKU-1', basePriceCents: 10000, dealDeskDiscountPct: 20, autoApprovalDiscountPct: 10, priceRules: [{ id: 'r1', minQuantity: 1, maxQuantity: 10, floorPriceCents: 6000, allowedTermMonths: [12] }] }; const line = (price, quantity = 2) => ({ productId: 'p1', quantity, unitPriceCents: price }); const exactFinance = mod.evaluateQuoteDraft([product], [line(9000)], 12); assert.equal(exactFinance.requiresFinanceApproval, false); const exactDesk = mod.evaluateQuoteDraft([product], [line(8000)], 12); assert.equal(exactDesk.requiresDealDesk, false); assert.equal(exactDesk.requiresFinanceApproval, true);

tests.name: unknown product is a 404 before any totals (ported)
tests.code: const product = { id: 'p1', sku: 'SKU-1', basePriceCents: 10000, dealDeskDiscountPct: 20, autoApprovalDiscountPct: 10, priceRules: [{ id: 'r1', minQuantity: 1, maxQuantity: 10, floorPriceCents: 6000, allowedTermMonths: [12] }] }; const line = (price, quantity = 2) => ({ productId: 'p1', quantity, unitPriceCents: price }); assert.throws(() => mod.evaluateQuoteDraft([], [line(9000)], 12), (e) => e.statusCode === 404);

items.findingRef: ww18 review rubric item 2 "The floor comparison is strict" (astraupskill/06-SOLUTIONS-AND-REVIEW.md:18)
